bullets: Own the frontend of a cinema chain with 12 locations: internal admin panels, the public website (planetakino.ua) and the cashier workstation (POS/ARM) systems used in every cinema.

Launched the cashier workstation (POS/ARM) from scratch — from the first prototype to rollout across all 12 cinemas; it is now the system front-desk staff work in every day. Built as a cross-platform Electron desktop app integrating payment terminals and barcode/QR scanners for virtual loyalty cards, tickets, receipts and orders.
Designed and built the authentication and access-control layer used across the admin panels and cashier workstations: role-based permission model, token refresh strategy and session security.

Migrated the codebase from Vue 2.6 to 2.7 and then to Vue 3: moved components from the Options API to the Composition API and state management from Vuex to Pinia, keeping the product shipping throughout.
Mentor a team of 5 frontend developers: review merge requests, set shared code and component standards, and onboard new engineers.
Raised PageSpeed scores to 90+ on key public pages and brought Core Web Vitals to target thresholds through rendering, asset and bundle optimization, and handled technical SEO with SSR in Nuxt.js.

Implemented auto-update for the Electron workstations, so new versions reach all 12 cinemas without on-site intervention, and built an application logging system that makes incidents on remote machines diagnosable without physical access to the till.
Delivered the chain's internal product suite end-to-end: an analytics system, a showtime scheduling tool, a visual builder for auditorium seat maps, and a marketing and promotions system.
Integrated LiqPay payments and receipt fiscalization through the Vchasno PRRO service, covering both online ticket sales and the in-cinema cashier workstations.
Set up Sentry from scratch across the web applications and the Electron workstations, giving the team visibility into production errors and cutting time to diagnose incidents.
Took part in launching the company's online streaming platform, implementing playback with HLS and Video.js and real-time updates over WebSockets.
Take part in designing and implementing the overall project architecture, and build the complex components and modules other developers reuse across products.
Delivered client-side applications for international clients end-to-end: designed the architecture, implemented the key modules and owned performance and maintainability.
Worked on a marketing platform for an advertising company: an admin panel that managed and delivered advertising content to 1,000+ tablets deployed across Ukraine.
Admin panel and B2B/B2C website for a Polish furniture factory.
Took part in building the admin panel for the "Choice" restaurant chain, covering the full flow — from creating a restaurant and its menu to order management and guest tipping.
Built a nationwide cartography service for Ukraine, working with cadastral and land-registry data.
Delivered both the desktop and the mobile version of the platform, focused on map rendering performance and usability on large datasets.
Took part in launching a streaming service from the ground up, building both the admin panel and the public website for a platform with 4,000+ active users.
Built the streaming experience for TV channels, movies and radio, including a custom video player on top of Video.js with HLS playback.
Developed the subscription flow and the user account area: plans, recurring billing and LiqPay payments.
Replaced BootstrapVue with custom in-house components, cutting bundle size by 45% and giving the team full control over the UI.
Contributed to system architecture, SEO and performance optimization.
